conditions.chapeau: These terms govern the use of DropLink, an online service that lets a seller create one tracking page per order. By creating an account, you accept them.

blocs.p: These terms govern access to and use of the DropLink service, available at droplink.fr. They form a contract between Mahfoud SEDDIKI, sole trader, publisher of the service (see the legal notice), and any person who creates an account, referred to below as “the seller”.
The seller's customer who views an order page has no account and is not a party to this contract. Their business relationship is with the seller, not with DropLink.

DropLink is a tracking and communication service, not a marketplace. The seller creates an order and adds photos or videos and a tracking number; DropLink generates a private page, reachable through a link that cannot be guessed, and queries the carrier to keep the status up to date.

blocs.h3: What the service does not include

ul: No sale and no payment between the seller and their customer: DropLink knows neither the seller's prices nor their margins.
No parcel delivery: DropLink is neither a carrier nor a shipping intermediary.
No guarantee on delivery times, which depend on the carrier chosen by the seller.

blocs.p: An order's link never changes. The seller can revoke it at any time, which disables it permanently and generates a new one.

ul: Creating an account requires a valid email address, or signing in with Google.
The seller guarantees that the information provided is accurate and keeps it up to date.
Credentials are personal and confidential. The seller is responsible for all activity carried out from their account.
Two-factor authentication is available in the settings and recommended.
The service is open to professional sellers and private individuals alike, provided they are of legal age.

blocs.p: The photos, videos and information the seller uploads remain their property. The seller grants DropLink the licence strictly necessary to provide the service: storing these files and displaying them on the order page reachable through the link. This licence ends when the content or the account is deleted.

The seller guarantees that they hold the rights to the published content, and undertakes not to include sensitive data or identifying details that are not needed to track the order. DropLink acts as a host: it does not review uploaded content in advance.

ul: Publishing unlawful, infringing, violent, hateful or sexual content.
Using the service to mislead a customer about the nature, origin or existence of a shipment.
Entering fake tracking numbers or numbers belonging to third-party shipments.
Trying to access another account's orders, or to enumerate order links.
Circumventing the limits of the plan, automating requests in bulk or degrading the service.

encart.texte: In the event of a breach, access to the account may be suspended immediately, without prejudice to any legal action. Suspension is reversible: reactivation restores the pages on the same links.

blocs.p: Anyone can report content they consider unlawful by writing to contact@droplink.fr. Every report is reviewed by a person, and the account concerned may be suspended as a precaution: its pages then immediately stop being served.
Content can also be reported from the report page, linked from the site's legal pages.
The seller is told the reason for a block and can contest it from their account.

ul: The Pro subscription is collected by Lemon Squeezy, reseller and issuer of the invoice, under its own terms of purchase. DropLink neither sees nor stores any card data.
It renews every month until cancelled.
A failed payment returns the account to the free plan; a successful payment restores the Pro plan.
No refund is made for a period that has started.

blocs.p: If you are a consumer, you have the right of withdrawal provided by law; it is exercised with Lemon Squeezy, reseller of the subscription, under its terms of purchase.
The seller can cancel their Pro subscription at any time from their Lemon Squeezy customer portal: the Pro plan stays active until the end of the period already paid.

The seller can delete their account at any time from the settings, once any subscription has been cancelled: DropLink refuses deletion while a charge can still occur. Deletion is immediate and removes orders, media and tracking; links already sent stop working. Only the following remain, as the privacy policy describes: the email address and the sign-up and deletion dates, for one year under the host's obligations, then erased automatically; the archives of subscription events, without name, email or card, for three years; the log of administration access. A suspended account cannot be deleted from the settings: the request is then made to contact@droplink.fr.
DropLink may terminate an account in the event of a breach of these terms, or with reasonable notice if the service is discontinued.
DropLink strives to keep the service continuously available, without guaranteeing that it will never be interrupted. The service may be interrupted for maintenance, change or be discontinued.
Automatic status updates depend on the information sent by carriers. Data that is unavailable, late or wrong on the carrier's side cannot be attributed to DropLink.

The DropLink brand, its logo, interface, texts and code are the property of Mahfoud SEDDIKI. No reproduction, extraction or reuse is permitted without written consent. The seller keeps full ownership of their brand, logo and content.

ul: DropLink is responsible for providing the service: hosting content, generating links, showing the statuses sent by carriers.
DropLink is not responsible for the reality of the sale, the conformity of the products, delivery times, or disputes between a seller and their customer.
The seller alone is responsible, towards their customers, for the information they publish on their order pages.
Subject to the mandatory provisions protecting consumers, DropLink's liability is limited to direct and foreseeable damage, up to the amounts paid over the last twelve months.

blocs.p: The processing of personal data is described in the privacy policy, which sets out the data collected, its purposes, its retention periods and the rights of the people concerned.

blocs.h3: Data of the seller's customers (Article 28 GDPR)

blocs.p: For the information the seller enters or uploads about their customers — name, photos, tracking number —, the seller is the controller and DropLink acts as processor, on the seller's instructions only: providing order pages and parcel tracking. As such, DropLink:

ul: uses this data only to provide the service;
protects it with appropriate security measures and imposes the same obligations on its own providers;
uses the providers listed in the privacy policy;
helps the seller answer requests from their customers;
deletes the data when the orders or the account are deleted;
informs the seller of any data breach that concerns them.

blocs.p: It is up to the seller to inform their customers of this processing.

These terms may change. Any substantial change is notified by email or in the application at least thirty days before it takes effect. Continuing to use the service after that date constitutes acceptance. The version in force is dated at the top of the page.

These terms are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, the parties first seek an amicable solution. Failing that, a dispute with a professional seller falls within the jurisdiction of the courts of Nanterre; a consumer keeps the benefit of the jurisdiction rules and protective provisions provided by law.
For any question about these terms: contact@droplink.fr.

docs.resume: DropLink turns an order into a tracking link you send to your customer. You add your photos and the tracking number; DropLink queries the carrier and updates the status on its own. This guide covers every screen, from creating your account to reading your <analyses>analytics</analyses>.
docs.presentationTexte: DropLink solves a single problem: customers asking ten times where their parcel is. The principle fits on one line.
docs.fait1: Create an order from the customer name, your photos and a tracking number.
docs.fait2: Generate a unique tracking page, in your colours, that the customer opens without an account.
docs.fait3: Pull carrier information and move the status forward automatically.
docs.fait4: Give you an overview: shipments in progress, parcels with no movement, links opened.
docs.faitPasTexte: DropLink is not a marketplace and does not manage your catalogue. You will find no products, quantities, prices, cart or revenue: that data belongs to your shop, not to your tracking.
docs.etape1Texte: By email or with Google, from the <lien>sign-up page</lien>. No bank card is required.
docs.etape2Texte: The name and logo appear at the top of every customer page.
docs.etape3Texte: You get a link to share straight away.
docs.combienTexte: An account takes under a minute, and the first tracking link goes out in the same session. There is no carrier integration to configure beforehand.
docs.marqueTexte: The My brand screen is an editor for your customer page, not a plain form: every change shows immediately in the preview.
docs.regLogoE: Shown in the header, next to the shop name.
docs.regNomE: Identify your shop to the customer.
docs.regCouleurE: Applied to the page accents. Default: #5B4BF5. Contrast is adjusted automatically so the text stays readable.
docs.regSociauxE: Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp and website, shown when filled in.
docs.regFiligraneE: Stamps your name on the photos you upload.
docs.commandeTexte: The Create an order button sits on the orders list. The form fits in three blocks, with the customer page preview alongside.
docs.blocClientTexte: The customer's name or handle, and an optional email. The email is only used to send the link; it creates no account.
docs.blocMediasTexte: Drop your files: the order, the packing, the sealed parcel.
docs.blocSuiviTexte: Paste the tracking number. DropLink recognises the carrier and starts querying it.
docs.sauvegardeTexte: The order saves itself as you fill it in. Adding a tracking number later is enough to start tracking.
docs.mediasTexte: Media are the heart of DropLink: they replace the back-and-forth messages. Add them by drag and drop or by picking files, and reorder them with the mouse or the keyboard.
docs.media1: Photos and videos are accepted. The first image is used as the cover.
docs.media2: Twenty media per order, including three videos.
docs.media3: The customer opens each photo full screen, and plays videos without leaving the page.
docs.suiviTexte: You have no status to enter. Paste the tracking number: DropLink queries the carrier and updates the page.
docs.suiviAlerteTitre: A freshly pasted number has not been scanned yet
docs.suiviAlerteTexte: It is not an error: the carrier simply has not published anything. The page says so, and never « number not found ».
docs.statutsTexte: The tracker has four steps, and it never goes backwards. Finer detail lives in the tracking history, not in the tracker.
docs.stPreparationE: The number is saved, the carrier has published nothing yet.
docs.stExpedieE: The carrier has picked up the parcel.
docs.stTransitE: The parcel is moving; every movement shows on the customer page.
docs.stLivreE: The carrier has confirmed the parcel was handed over.
docs.silenceTitre: Silence is named after ten days
docs.silenceTexte: A parcel with no movement for more than ten days is flagged, on the Shipments screen and on the customer page. Named silence is information; unexplained silence reads as a failure.
docs.lienTexte: Every order has its own link. Your customer opens it without an account, on mobile or desktop, and finds your photos, the parcel status, the movement history and your contact details if you filled them in.
docs.lienAlerteTitre: The link never changes on its own
docs.lienAlerteTexte: You can edit an order you already sent: the customer sees the update on the same link. Only « revoke and regenerate » creates a new address, and it cuts off the old one for good.
docs.envoisTexte: The Shipments screen groups all your parcels, regardless of orders. It is the view to open when you look for what has stopped moving: the default sort brings immobile parcels to the top.
docs.analysesTexte: Analytics measure your use of DropLink and the effectiveness of your tracking. No revenue data appears: DropLink does not know your prices.
docs.notificationsTexte: Your customer can ask, from their order page, to be notified by email. They confirm their address, then receive at most three messages — shipped, in transit, delivered —, each with an unsubscribe link. They never create an account.
docs.plansTexte: DropLink has a free plan and a Pro plan. The free plan allows {gratuit} orders in total, a lifetime quota, it does not reset each month. Pro raises it to {pro} orders per month and removes the DropLink mention from the page your customer sees.
docs.plansTexteSansNombre: DropLink has a free plan and a Pro plan. The free plan allows a limited number of orders in total, a lifetime quota, it does not reset each month. Pro replaces it with a monthly limit and removes the DropLink mention from the page your customer sees.
docs.faqQ1: Does my customer need an account?
docs.faqR1: No. They open the link and see their order immediately, with no signup and nothing to install.
docs.faqQ2: Do I have to update the status myself?
docs.faqR2: No. The tracking number is enough: DropLink queries the carrier and moves the status on its own.
docs.faqQ3: Can I create an order without a tracking number?
docs.faqR3: Yes. Create it, share the link, and add the number once the parcel ships: the customer sees the update on the same link.
docs.faqR4: No. DropLink handles no catalogue, no payment and no prices: only tracking and customer communication.
docs.faqQ5: How long does my link stay active?
docs.faqR5: As long as you want. A link does not expire on its own: only « revoke and regenerate » replaces it.
docs.faqQ6: What does my customer see if I revoked the link?
docs.faqR6: A DropLink page explaining the link is no longer valid and inviting them to contact you. It reveals nothing about your shop.
docs.supportTexte: A question not answered here? Write to us at <courriel>contact@droplink.fr</courriel>: every message reaches the product team.
docs.ctaTitre: Ready to create your first link?
docs.ctaTexte: Free account, no credit card, ready in under a minute.
docs.metaDescription: The complete DropLink guide: create an order, add your photos, paste the tracking number and share a customer link.
docs.param1: Account: name, email and password, the email and password only change with your current password.
docs.param2: Preferences: interface language. The language of customer pages is set in My brand.
docs.param3: Security: two-factor authentication, active sessions, account deletion.
docs.param4: Data: export your data, delete everything, every destructive action asks for confirmation.
docs.param5: Subscription: current plan. During the validation phase, DropLink is free.
docs.kpiCreesE: Number of orders created over the period.
docs.kpiLivreesE: Orders the carrier has confirmed as delivered.
docs.kpiLiensE: Number of times your tracking pages were opened.
docs.kpiDelaiE: Average time between the carrier taking the parcel and delivering it.
docs.analysesSuite: On top of that: order trends over 7, 30 or 90 days, status breakdown, carrier usage and recent activity.
docs.clientVoit1: Your logo, the shop name and your social links.
docs.clientVoit2: The order reference and the estimated delivery date.
docs.clientVoit3: A tracking rail: Not scanned yet, Shipped, In transit, Delivered.
docs.clientVoit4: Your photos and videos of the order.
docs.clientVoit5: The carrier and the tracking number.
docs.clientVoit6: The detailed history of tracking events.
docs.transporteursTexte: The carrier is recognised from the tracking number. The <analyses>Analytics</analyses> screen shows how your shipments split between carriers.

vendeur.vuesTitre: Who looked, and how many times
vendeur.vuesTexte: Every link opening is counted. A customer who keeps coming back is a reassured customer.
vendeur.envoisTitre: All your parcels on one screen
vendeur.envoisTexte: The latest update of every parcel, collected from the carrier. No more opening ten tracking sites.

tarifs.legende: Comparison of the Free and Pro plans
tarifs.coin: Both plans track your parcels on their own and keep the same link from start to finish.

questions.q1: Does my customer need to create an account?
questions.r1: No. They open the link and see their order, on a phone or a computer. No app, no password.
questions.r2: Paste the tracking number: the carrier is detected automatically, and you can pick it by hand if it isn’t. The steps update without you having to come back to the order.
questions.q3: Can I edit the order after sending the link?
questions.r3: Yes, as often as you like. Photos, number, status: your customer sees the up-to-date version on the same link, which never changes.
